segments.sn51.31:1.2: “taṃ kiṃ maññatha, bhikkhave, katamesaṃ dhammānaṃ bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā moggallāno bhikkhu evaṃmahiddhiko evaṃmahānubhāvo”ti?
segments.sn51.31:2.1: Bhagavaṃmūlakā no, bhante, dhammā bhagavaṃnettikā … pe …“catunnaṃ kho, bhikkhave, iddhipādānaṃ bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā moggallāno bhikkhu evaṃmahiddhiko evaṃmahānubhāvo”.
segments.sn51.31:3.2: Idha, bhikkhave, moggallāno bhikkhu chandasamādhippadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgataṃ iddhipādaṃ bhāveti –
segments.sn51.31:3.3: ‘iti me chando na ca atilīno bhavissati, na ca atippaggahito bhavissati, na ca ajjhattaṃ saṃkhitto bhavissati, na ca bahiddhā vikkhitto bhavissati’.
segments.sn51.31:3.5: ‘yathā pure tathā pacchā, yathā pacchā tathā pure;
segments.sn51.31:3.6: yathā adho tathā uddhaṃ, yathā uddhaṃ tathā adho;
segments.sn51.31:3.7: yathā divā tathā rattiṃ, yathā rattiṃ tathā divā’.
segments.sn51.31:3.8: Iti vivaṭena cetasā apariyonaddhena sappabhāsaṃ cittaṃ bhāveti.
segments.sn51.31:3.9: Vīriyasamādhi … pe … cittasamādhi … pe … vīmaṃsāsamādhippadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgataṃ iddhipādaṃ bhāveti –
segments.sn51.31:3.12: ‘iti me vīmaṃsā na ca atilīnā bhavissati, na ca atippaggahitā bhavissati, na ca ajjhattaṃ saṃkhittā bhavissati, na ca bahiddhā vikkhittā bhavissati’… pe … iti vivaṭena cetasā apariyonaddhena sappabhāsaṃ cittaṃ bhāveti.
segments.sn51.31:3.14: Imesaṃ kho, bhikkhave, catunnaṃ iddhipādānaṃ bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā moggallāno bhikkhu evaṃmahiddhiko evaṃmahānubhāvo.
segments.sn51.31:4.1: “Imesañca pana, bhikkhave, catunnaṃ iddhipādānaṃ bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā moggalāno bhikkhu evaṃ anekavihitaṃ iddhividhaṃ paccanubhoti – ekopi hutvā bahudhā hoti, bahudhāpi hutvā eko hoti … pe … yāva brahmalokāpi kāyena vasaṃ vatteti.
segments.sn51.31:4.2: Imesañca pana, bhikkhave, catunnaṃ iddhipādānaṃ bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā moggallāno bhikkhu āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharatī”ti.
